item.title: How Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) and the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) are Reshaping China’s Soft Power?
item.description:
This study makes a critical appraisal of Joseph Nye’s concept of Soft Power and

analyses how the Chinese scholars and policy makers are transforming its usage and

conceptual applicability as China stands for globalization, multilateralism, common

and shared goals for the planet and humanity. Given COVID 19, China’s soft power

appeal could have political and security implications for the global world order.

**In a world where emerging geopolitics is increasingly making Hard Power/Military Might as the new reality, does Soft Power really matter? If you are curious download the paper & give your feedback…
